prose: Prepared remarks from a Congressional briefing lay out a state of the union on open models through the lens of US-China competition. The author distinguishes open-weight models (public weights governed by licenses - Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek) from true open-source models, which also ship training code and data. Since about April 2025, Chinese companies have been the clear leaders in open-weight models, while the most prominent fully open-source models have been built in the United States.
highlights: Written as a briefing for Congressional members and staff.
Open-weight (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek) vs. open-source (weights plus training code and data).
Chinese AI companies have led open-weight models since about April 2025.
The most prominent open-source models are US-built.
